title: ‘Five Nights at Freddy’s’ to Open Real Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza Location in 2027
content:
ByMya Copeland

“Five Nights at Freddy’s” and New Jersey entertainment and retail center American Dream will open a real-life Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza location in East Rutherford, N.J., in 2027.

Based on the “Five Nights at Freddy’s” franchise, the immersive restaurant experience is a functional reimagining of the game’s location, designed in collaboration with IP holder ScottGames.

The pizzeria will be a quick-service dining experience featuring two animatronic stage shows: the Main Stage with Freddy and the Fazbear Band, and the Pirate Cove with Foxy the Pirate. Fans can eat, play arcade games, watch an animatronic show and participate in survival horror multiplayer game experiences.

“The only way this experience succeeds is if it’s created by a team that knows ‘Five Nights at Freddy’s’ inside and out,” said Atreyu Alcantar, creative manager, licensing & location-based entertainment at American Dream and creative lead for the attraction. “The animatronic show has to be authentic. The food has to be high quality. And above all else, we’re not building a set that looks like Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza – we’re building Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza. This experience will immerse longtime fans in the world they’ve imagined for years while welcoming an entirely new audience to discover it for the first time.”

“Five Nights at Freddy’s” originated as a video game series and has since expanded into novels, graphic novels and films. Created by Scott Cawthon, the game’s story arcs typically follow a character attempting to survive attacks from homicidal animatronic characters. The locations are connected to the fictional pizza restaurant franchise Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza.

American Dream’s other attractions include DreamWorks Water Park, Nickelodeon Universe Theme Park, Sesame Street Learn & Play, Legoland Discovery Center and Sea Life Aquarium.
title_zh: 《五夜驚魂(Five Nights at Freddy’s)》將於2027年開設真實的弗雷迪·法茲貝爾披薩(Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza)地點。
content_zh:
由Mya Copeland報導

《五夜驚魂(Five Nights at Freddy’s)》與新澤西州的娛樂與零售中心美國夢(American Dream)將於2027年在新澤西州厄斯特·拉瑟福德(East Rutherford)開設一個真實的弗雷迪·法茲貝爾披薩(Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza)地點。

這家沉浸式餐廳體驗基於《五夜驚魂》系列，功能性地重新想像了遊戲中的地點，並與知識產權持有者斯科特·高森(Scott Cawthon)合作設計。

這家披薩店將提供快速服務的用餐體驗，特色包括兩場機械玩偶舞台表演：主舞台上有弗雷迪(Freddy)和法茲貝爾樂隊(Fazbear Band)，以及海盜灣(Pirate Cove)的海盜狐狸(Foxy the Pirate)。粉絲們可以在這裡用餐、玩街機遊戲、觀看機械玩偶表演，並參加生存恐怖的多人遊戲體驗。

美國夢的創意經理、授權及基於地點的娛樂部門負責人阿特雷尤·阿爾坎塔(Atreyu Alcantar)表示：「這個體驗的成功唯一的途徑就是由一支對《五夜驚魂》瞭若指掌的團隊來創造。機械玩偶表演必須真實，食物必須高品質。最重要的是，我們不是在建造一個看起來像弗雷迪·法茲貝爾披薩的場景——我們是在建造弗雷迪·法茲貝爾披薩。這個體驗將使長期粉絲沉浸在他們多年來所想像的世界中，同時歡迎全新的觀眾首次發現它。」

《五夜驚魂》最初是一個視頻遊戲系列，隨後擴展到小說、漫畫和電影。該遊戲由斯科特·高森創作，故事情節通常圍繞一個角色試圖在兇殺機械玩偶的攻擊下生存。這些地點與虛構的披薩餐廳連鎖弗雷迪·法茲貝爾披薩有關。

美國夢的其他景點包括夢工廠水上樂園(DreamWorks Water Park)、尼克國際主題公園(Nickelodeon Universe Theme Park)、芝麻街學習與遊戲(Sesame Street Learn & Play)、樂高探索中心(Legoland Discovery Center)和海洋生物水族館(Sea Life Aquarium)。
